apps.name: Adobe Government Forum 2026
apps.description:
This is the official mobile app for the Adobe Government Forum 2026, taking place in Washington, D.C., on February 5. Designed for professionals in the public sector, defense, and industry, the app provides full access to the event agenda, session tracks, and speaker information. Download it now to:

- Browse and bookmark sessions that align with your mission-related interests
- Explore the speaker lineup and venue details
- Receive real-time push notifications about schedule updates and networking opportunities
- Easily access information on every session and contact

Join us to explore how governments are leveraging digital experiences, generative AI, and content-velocity strategies to modernize service delivery, enhance employee experiences, and put people at the heart of every mission.

apps.name: Adobe Government Forum 2024
apps.description:
For Government Forum attendees
Download the Gov Forum mobile app to stay connected during the conference. The Gov Forum app provides the latest information to help you get the most out of your experience. Manage your schedule, connect with other attendees, and view the agenda, announcements, and conference maps. For more details about the Adobe Government Forum—a digital experience conference for government—please visit https://reg.adobe.com/flow/adobe/agf24/landingpage/page/home.

apps.description:
Microsoft Copilot: Your Personal AI Assistant for Every Task

Copilot is your personal AI assistant, always ready to help with any task—whether it’s a work project, a creative idea, or your daily to-do list. Powered by Microsoft’s advanced AI technology, Copilot makes completing any task faster, easier, and more convenient.

WHY CHOOSE COPILOT?

More Than Just an AI Chatbot
Experience AI conversations that feel natural and intuitive. Copilot understands context, adapts to your needs, and provides thoughtful responses that help you achieve more.

Mico: Your Visual AI Assistant
Meet Mico, Copilot’s revolutionary visual AI assistant. Using real-life expressions, Mico makes interactions feel even more personal and engaging. Get help in a whole new way from an AI that truly interacts with you.

POWERFUL FEATURES

Create Stunning Visuals
Turn your ideas into beautiful images with AI-powered image generation. Create logos, illustrations, and social media content using just a few words.

View and Analyze
Analyze images, extract insights from photos, and perform visual searches using Vision. Simply share an image, and Copilot will help you understand what you’re looking at. Built-in Smart Learning Tools
• Flashcards for effective study sessions
• Live learning with Mico for interactive education
• Quiz mode to test your knowledge
• Educational support tailored to your pace

Audio-Based Learning
Explore podcasts created just for you. Get explanations of complex topics in an accessible audio format.

Work Smarter, Not Harder
• Draft emails, presentations, and reports in seconds
• Summarize complex information
• Translate text and check spelling in multiple languages
• Create grocery lists, meal plans, and travel itineraries
• Get help writing resumes, cover letters, and reports

Voice Chat Support
Interact with Copilot naturally using voice chat. Generate ideas, create content, or get quick answers—all hands-free.

WHO IS IT FOR?

• Students looking for educational support and study tools
• Professionals needing help with work tasks and productivity
• Creatives seeking inspiration or looking to generate images
• Anyone who needs a reliable AI assistant for everyday life

HOW COPILOT HELPS YOU

Get direct answers to complex questions through simple, natural conversations. Perhaps you are planning a trip, preparing for a presentation, or exploring new ideas. Whatever you are doing, Copilot is there to help when you need it most. Experience an AI that boosts your confidence, sparks creativity, and helps you achieve more every single day.

Download Microsoft Copilot and meet your new AI assistant today.
